title: SRE-01 Workshop — Metrics
description: EDOT / Managed OTLP app metrics on metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* (http.server.request.total datapoints). Same layout as Platform logs.

data_source.query: FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*)
FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE metrics.`http.server.request.total` IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT(*)
FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.`http.response.status_code` >= 500 | STATS count = COUNT(*)
FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), resource.attributes.`service.name`
FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.`service.name`
FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.`service.name` | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.`http.response.status_code` IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY attributes.`http.response.status_code` | SORT count DESC

FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.`http.response.status_code` >= 500 | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.`service.name`, attributes.`http.response.status_code` | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 25

FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.`geo.country_iso_code` IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.`geo.country_iso_code`

FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.`geo.country_iso_code` IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.`geo.country_iso_code` | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10
